nodes.label: Tardive Dyskinesia Movement and Exposure Rule
nodes.rationale: Choreiform movements over 4 weeks with 3-month blocker exposure (1 month at 60+) and withdrawal-onset windows separate tardive from acute movements.

nodes.label: Schooler-Kane AIMS Research Threshold
nodes.rationale: Moderate in one region or mild in two (AIMS 3+ once or 2+ twice) is a research threshold that supports measurement without independently establishing diagnosis.
